card.name: Skin pigmentation and UV-light wording
card.fires_on: Linking words and digits inside label sentences about skin pigmentation, ultraviolet light or PUVA, and also inside dose strings like 1,200 mg. It lands on small words such as 'to', 'of', 'the' and on '-induced'.

modes.label: Pigment and UV phrases
modes.description: Small linking words or '-induced' inside sentences about melanin, pigmentation, ultraviolet light or PUVA.
modes.example: The pigmentation change is due<< to>> increased melanin content in the melanocytes

modes.label: Digits in dose numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a dose figure or section number in a dosing line.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in skin-darkening and UV-light sentences, and on digits in dose figures.
